verdict.rationale: PagerDuty documents Incident Workflows with configurable triggers and actions that apply "if-this-then-that" logic, for example auto-triggering on all P1/P2 incidents. Event Orchestration rules automatically deduplicate or suppress alerts, AI Orchestrations surface recommended rules from historical events, and workflow actions can send webhook POSTs. Escalation policies automate assignment, which a community user independently confirms works well. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of Incident Workflows and Event Orchestration rule-building specifically (community evidence covers only escalation).
